text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During an outing with Inari One, just as 
we started to feel a bit peckish—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Shall we get some food soon? Is there 
anything you're craving?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What's with the half-hearted attitude? You 
really sayin' anything goes?
choice_data_list: Hmm... as long as it fills our bellies...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hmm, is that so? Anything, huh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Well, that actually makes things even 
more interesting! This great Inari just 
came up with a brilliant idea.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
How about a little side game? We draw lots 
to decide what we're eating—what do ya 
say?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Guess I'll whip up the lottery 
real quick then!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Alright! That's pretty much that!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, draw a ticket. Once you open 
the paper, the shop's name will be on it.
choice_data_list:
By the way, what kinds of shops are among 
the choices?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, curious? I was just about to announce 
that right now.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
“—First, the town's specialty: the famous, 
ultra-spicy hot pot from 'Agonizing Super 
Mala.'”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Pop open the lid of the cauldron 
of hell, and you'll find a crimson 
scorching inferno. They say one bite'll 
keep the fire burning for three days 
straight!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, the others aren't any less 
impressive either! 'Tokumori Dojo', the 
competitive-eating restaurant where 
Umamusume food fighters clash daily and 
leaving leftovers is strictly forbidden!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The bug cuisine specialty shop, "Survival 
Instinct"! The taste is top-notch, but you 
need some nerve to try it! There's a whole 
bunch of other fun shops lined up too, 
heheh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, can't forget this. There's also that 
classic onigiri shop, Toyouke-an. Their 
inari sushi is seriously delicious too.
choice_data_list: That's what's so great about it...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that kind of thing is up to the 
gods. Well, just go ahead and draw one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What started as a casual remark turned 
into a huge deal. Pleading desperately for 
the final shop, I nervously drew a ticket—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, Toyoukean, huh? Man, you've got some 
crazy luck!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. Now that it's settled, let's go 
buy them right away. I know a spot nearby 
with a great view, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so we moved on to the shop in 
question, bought some inari sushi, and 
headed to the scenic spot that Inari One 
recommended."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Gaaah! This is the stuff! This sweet and 
savory flavor is simply irresistible!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"How's that, Trainer-san? Knowing you won 
it in a lottery makes it taste the 
absolute best, don't it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I nodded without hesitation, for some 
reason Inari One began to snicker quietly.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Pffft... Ahhahaha!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ah, nah. Sorry about that, Trainer. Looks 
like I went and caused some trouble.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
About that raffle... The truth is, from 
the very start, it only had tickets for 
the rice ball shop in it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, since you told me anything goes, 
Lady Inari just couldn't resist a little 
mischief, you see.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Boss, eating good food in a place 
with a great view like this really hits 
different, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Big Sis, eating good food in a 
place with a great view like this really 
hits different, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Even when it comes to a single meal, you 
can't be careless. You've gotta make sure 
you don't forget to take proper care of 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...After all, this fleeting world is a 
tough place. Things rarely go as smoothly 
as you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why. No matter what, 
keep a cool head. That way, whatever 
happens, you can stand firm and enjoy it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Inari One talking while gazing at the 
sky. Could that prank have been her way of 
passing down that quintessential Edokko 
spirit, I wonder—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, went on a bit of a tangent there. 
Well, anyway, having that kind of mindset 
is what being "chic" is all about!
choice_data_list: I want to become a classy person too.
I want to become a refined person too.
Still, this inari sushi is delicious!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, went on a bit of a tangent there. 
Well, anyway, having that kind of mindset 
is what being "chic" is all about!
choice_data_list: I want to become a classy person too.
I want to become a refined person too.
Still, this inari sushi is delicious!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, no need to worry about that. After 
all, you've got a role model right by your 
side!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That said, I ain't gonna spell it out 
every single time like I just did. 
Overexplaining things ain't stylish.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the day... it just means 
follow my lead!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Weren't you listening?! Sheesh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Well, it's fine. Doesn't change the fact 
that I pulled a prank, after all.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Eat up and enjoy. ...Heh.
